# Excaliflow attribution

Excaliflow by Shubham Saboo and contributors, distributed under Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps/tree/fba2c90c568b3a61d8080be5cee38ed6908d8779/advanced_llm_apps/excaliflow
Upstream index.html revision: fba2c90c568b3a61d8080be5cee38ed6908d8779.

TuitionManager modifications (2026-11-16): disabled shared localStorage; added a same-origin parent message bridge for authenticated per-board persistence; start new boards empty; use local fonts and remove external font stylesheet requests. Responsive tool-island wrapping and a collapsed mobile properties panel keep drawing/export controls reachable on phones. Duplicate canvas navigation buttons are hidden on phones; equivalent commands remain in the canvas menu and bottom dock. Original drawing, export and workspace tools remain.

Font notices are in fonts/: Excalifont (SIL OFL 1.1, Excalidraw), Virgil (Excalidraw MIT distribution), Cascadia (SIL OFL 1.1, Microsoft). The bundled Excalifont file is the Latin subset shipped by upstream.
